annotations.text: Final direction: Sketch B's dense spacing, with the live half indicator (1ST/2ND/HT) recolored to the site's forest-green accent instead of rust. Red-card tick above the score stays red — that's a distinct signal from match status.

Sketch A — Left Badge, Standard Density
Badge moves to a slim 36px column at the left edge: FT / 1ST / 2ND / HT. Kickoff time sits where the score goes pre-match. Red tick above the score marks a red card.

Sketch B — Left Badge, Dense
Same structure as A, tightened padding/gaps/type for a denser list. This density was picked as final — see the Final page for the recolored version.

Sketch C — Live Minute Clock
Live matches show a running minute ("24’") in forest green instead of 1ST/2ND text. Not picked, but its green live color carried over into the Final.
